title: Successful executor-interlock CI does not yet execute the newly added result-free true pre-dispatch constructor path
claim_under_test: GitHub Actions run 33202612826 establishes executable repository-CI evidence for the new result-free NativeChildBinding -> PREPARED EffectCallBinding -> POST result -> return binding sequence introduced by e8b9088580dce7ce451fcf21a185792ed834c3c8.

observations.fact: The source now accepts a result-free NativeChildBinding in prepare_effect_call(), emits return_id=None for true PRE-dispatch state, and adds bind_effect_return() for later WP-104 correlation.

The test file is unchanged from the pre-fix version. setUp() still constructs DeferredExecutionVerificationTarget objects after result binding and RecordExecution, then calls prepare_effect_call(target,...). It does not call prepare_effect_call() with a result-free NativeChildBinding and does not call bind_effect_return().
Executor-interlock tests construct EffectCallBinding directly. They validate gate/executor behavior but do not prove the new result-free constructor or later return-binding transition.

The hosted job materially executed setup, compile, PRE-POST regression, and executor-interlock falsifier steps; this is real repository-CI execution, but the executed tests above do not cover the new result-free path.

reason: Compilation proves the new API is syntactically/import-valid and the unchanged legacy/result-bound correlation plus interlock regressions still pass. It does not prove that a result-free NativeChildBinding can traverse the intended PRE -> POST -> return-bound -> verification sequence or that the new rejection/ordering invariants behave correctly.
required_deterministic_successor_tests: Construct a result-free NativeChildBinding and prove prepare_effect_call(binding,effect_id) returns PREPARED with return_id=null before result_id/result_sha256 exist.
Reject prepare_effect_call() when NativeChildBinding already has a result on the true PRE-dispatch path.
Observe a typed POST result with exact effect/invocation/tool/delegation/binding/child identity and prove mismatches fail closed.
Construct the later result-bound DeferredExecutionVerificationTarget and prove bind_effect_return() attaches the exact return_id only after POST correlation.
Reject WP105 verification while return_id is absent even when a POST result exists.
After exact return binding, prove the existing separate VerifyExecution transition can proceed without collapsing reported execution into world verification.
Interleave two same-session calls A/B through PRE(A), PRE(B), POST(A), POST(B), bind-return(B), bind-return(A) and reject every swapped effect/call/result/return identity.
Exact replay of already observed POST and return binding remains idempotent; mutated replay fails closed.
counterhypothesis: The compile step plus unchanged compatibility tests may be considered sufficient because the new path is a small type-generalization of already-tested logic.
falsifier_for_counterhypothesis: A branch-specific semantic defect can exist only in the new NativeChildBinding path or bind_effect_return() while compilation and all legacy tests still pass. Direct deterministic tests of those branches are therefore required before granting true-pre-dispatch runtime/component credit.
next_exact_action_for_active_mutation_au: Add the result-free PRE -> POST -> bind_effect_return -> VerifyExecution deterministic matrix to the existing effect-correlation CI, rerun on exact source, and emit a bounded receipt. After that, resolve the separate canonical EffectGate/EffectJournal executable implementation binding before production integration.
